data.content_ref: inline:The target fails to satisfy the requirement to specify exactly what must be durably recorded. Its mechanism requires both a birth certificate and a redo log capturing every idempotent write so that a new incarnation can reconstruct workspace state and determine completion, yet its claim identifies only the birth certificate as the durable record. By omitting the redo log, the specification is incomplete and does not state the exact set of durable records the protocol must maintain.
